verdicts.decision_note: The client raises a material uncertainty about whether the interior title page should contain only the title, subtitle, and author name without an image.
The paperback confirmation concerns the overall publication format and does not specifically modify the interior title-page scope.
The client materially questions the author-name placement on the interior title page, and the adjacent response confirms that the issue concerns title-page ordering.
The client accepts retaining the current author-name-first title-page arrangement and the existing emphasis on the main title; no prior value keys require removal.
The client's acceptance resolves the title-page ordering uncertainty and returns the Requirement from clarification to active status.
